BOOK SIZE: 5 seats. This is the second week in a row that only the holds survive. The dilution bar is the median held seat at +44.5%. Kia (+42.1%, rr 2.67, skeptic minor) is the only clean grade-A name near it, and it falls short on ER and would be a fourth auto-demand-cycle seat. I rejected the swap: 9980.HK is impaired, not broken, its computed risk/reward (0.96) is barely below Harmony's (1.05), and the 2026-11-12 reliability review shows the debate filters but does not rank the top. A ~10pp ER gap between an A and a B is therefore not a reliable enough signal to churn a held seat. A small book that is not diluted beats a padded one.

HARD NO-SEATS this week, so the reader knows they were weighed: skeptic REFUTED at kill_scope moat = 9618.HK, PTEC.L (the company's own 2026-11-10 trading update warned that 2027 will be tougher on third-party supply), RENT3.SA (filed ROE 7-9% FY22-FY25, below the cost of capital), RITM, SSRM (gold price-taker with AISC guided ~10% above range), ZEAL.CO and 2601.HK. Basket-13 event names (CDI.PA offer, PPC buyout committee, PBT unit conversion, VAL merger) are ineligible here by STEP 3b.

MACRO: risk_stance BALANCED. Quadrant REFLATION (quadrant_inputs ok): real GDP +3.37% annualised (2026-07), CPI 6m-annualised 3.07% and 3m-annualised 5.72%. The October CPI print (+0.4% m/m, 2026-11-10) and payrolls of +165k (2026-11-06) keep inflation sticky. The playbook is pricing power and cash-now cyclical value over long-duration multiples. Debt-cycle phase DISCIPLINE (18 weeks, cycle_score 0.751, pending_target FORCING 1/2, gold -16% over 6 months, consistent). This caps the stance at balanced and permits the 18-month horizon. The regime read AGREES on both dials (confidence MED). The 30y at 5.47% sits 3bp from 5.50% with FORCING pending 1 of 2 ticks, so this is an active FORCING watch. If next week confirms it, the stance floors at defensive, reaches are suspended, and this book is already built for that: three net-cash or low-leverage cash-now seats plus two carry seats, with no story-duration seat. Catalyst Watch tilt (2026-11-02 read, v10): three shared drivers are BREACHED at once - credit (CCC-BB above 1,100bp), AI-capex (SOXX -17.1% in October, plus the hyperscaler funding latch), and oil/Hormuz (Brent at or above $110 for seven sessions). No current seat resolves on any of the three. Inflation resilience (REFLATION, so it is weighed): INCH.L, DUE.DE and LRN are RESILIENT, 9980.HK is UNKNOWN (no penalty), and 0175.HK is MIXED. (2) November payrolls below 50k or unemployment at or above 4.3% (by 2026-12-05). (3) November ISM Manufacturing below 50 plus a second Empire State reading below 10 (by 2026-12-02). (4) Q3 GDP second estimate below 2.0% or GDPNow Q4 below 1.5% (by 2026-12-23). Phase falsifiers: (a) a 30y close above 5.50% on 3+ sessions plus a tailing December 30y reopening points to FORCING (by 2026-12-31). (b) 2s30s steepening more than 25bp from 59bp with the 2y flat or lower, a term-premium break, points to FORCING (by 2026-12-31). (c) the December FOMC citing Treasury market functioning, or halting runoff for market reasons, starts a MONETIZATION watch (by 2026-12-17). (d) a 30y back below 5.00% with real 30y below 2.8% means the phase call was late, i.e. EXPANSION (by 2027-01-31).

CORRELATION / EXPOSURE STRESS (result: PASS, one factor at its cap). (a) Demand-cycle beta: 0175.HK, INCH.L and DUE.DE all ride the auto cycle. That is exactly 3, the hidden-factor ceiling, so a combined cap of 1.9 units binds them, and it is the second reason Kia stays out. LRN (state-funded schooling) and 9980.HK (staple drink) are demand-inelastic. (b) Regulatory jurisdiction: no shared sign-off. China/HK sentiment carries 2 names (0175.HK, 9980.HK), within budget, and there is no sector_regulatory convergence pair in the book. (c) Liquidity/de-gross: DUE.DE and LRN are mid-caps and there is no small-cap cluster. (d) Posture: 1 wait_for_weakness seat (DUE.DE at EUR 15.0) and 2 on_confirmation seats on non-overlapping dates (LRN ~2027-01-26, 9980.HK by 2027-04-30), so this is not a correlated flush bet. (e) Secular themes: retail-channel-shift (INCH.L) and ai-displacement (LRN) carry one name each. European-cyclical-recession plus correlated de-gross scenario: DUE.DE and INCH.L (European/UK listings, auto-cycle) and 0175.HK (auto) would fall together. The ballast is LRN and 9980.HK, and all three cyclicals sit on net-cash or low-leverage balance sheets: Geely's net cash is about a third of market value, Inchcape runs ~0.5x, Durr's net debt is modest. The scenario dents the book but breaks no thesis. None of the three breached Catalyst Watch drivers runs through a seat. Sequencing: DUE.DE adds only at EUR 15.0, and nothing else is bought this week.

SECULAR-THEME CONCENTRATION: no theme carries 2 or more names (retail-channel-shift: INCH.L only; ai-displacement: LRN only), so no secular-theme combined_caps entry is needed. The one binding cap is the hidden-factor auto-demand-cycle cap of 1.9 units over 0175.HK + INCH.L + DUE.DE. Note FORK 2/B: the book is published equal-weight, so these caps are advisory audit-trail only.

BEAR REBUTTAL
0175.HK: ROIC is ~2.5% and the headline net cash is partly supplier credit, so the 'cheap on cash' case may be a low-return carmaker correctly priced into a price war that has not ended.
INCH.L: Inchcape does not own its customers; OEMs can take distribution in-house market by market, as its own CEO conceded on 2026-07-28, so the cash return may be a melting ice cube.
DUE.DE: The screen's cheapness came from a disposal gain and a cash pull-forward, and 2026 FCF is guided negative, so a European capex recession could push the parts value below EUR 12.
LRN: Enrollment fell 2.8% and applications declined after management misjudged demand twice, so the growth engine may have stalled for good and the 13% FCF yield is peak cash.
9980.HK: Revenue growth went from ~36% to ~0% in four halves, which looks like category saturation against Red Bull and Monster, so the multiple may compress further even with net cash.
